worldcombat.skill.flareblitz.summary: Charge into a target, dealing damage, knocking it back and possibly burning it. A successful hit causes recoil damage.
worldcombat.skill.flareblitz.description: The burning hit deals about %1$s contact damage; it charges up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s block hit radius.

If the target is not burning yet, a hit has a %1$s chance to burn it and knocks it %3$s blocks along the charge; the user then takes %2$s times the damage dealt as recoil. The burn lasts %4$s, halving physical attacks and costing about 1/16 of maximum health every 5 s; Fire-types and other naturally immune targets cannot be lit. It stops on the first target it hits, when the charge distance is spent, or on a wall or block; a whiff only snuffs the fire, with no recoil.
worldcombat.skill.flareblitz.afterburn.o: Afterburn: much higher burn chance, heavier recoil, slower start, shorter charge and weaker knockback - trade the burst for lasting pressure.
Burst: higher power, charge and knockback, lighter recoil and a faster rhythm, but it barely ignites the target - a one-shot burst.
worldcombat.skill.flareblitz.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, cost %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.flareblitz.growth.0: From level %1$s the impact power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.flareblitz.growth.1: From level %1$s the impact power rises to %2$s, the burn chance to %3$s%% and the recoil to %4$s times.
worldcombat.skill.flareblitz.use.0: Ram a target that is in your face with a burning charge
worldcombat.skill.flareblitz.use.1: Set a healthy carry alight with a burn
worldcombat.skill.flareblitz.use.2: In the open, shove a target into its allies or off a ledge
